thinkingModes.name: Self-Consistency / Quality Gate
thinkingModes.whenUseful: Use before important final outputs, handoffs, reports, instructions, or recommendations.
thinkingModes.practicalValue: Check coherence, missing pieces, contradictions, usability, and whether the output matches the stated goal.

thinkingModes.name: ReAct / Action-Oriented Reasoning
thinkingModes.whenUseful: Use when the task requires implementation, debugging, testing, execution, or stepwise verification.
thinkingModes.practicalValue: Take the next practical action, observe the result, adjust the plan, and verify the outcome.

thinkingModes.name: Decision Review
thinkingModes.whenUseful: Use when the user needs to choose, accept, reject, approve, or prioritize a path.
thinkingModes.practicalValue: Compare decision criteria, trade-offs, risks, and expected value, then recommend one path.

thinkingModes.name: Step-Back Reasoning
thinkingModes.whenUseful: Use when the request is unclear, broad, messy, or likely needs reframing before execution.
thinkingModes.practicalValue: Briefly restate the real goal, name the missing or hidden frame, then proceed with the most useful interpretation.
